core_message: The MOAB was an improvised giant designed for shock, trading heavy armor-piercing steel for pure explosive blast pressure.
title: Why the MOAB uses thin aluminum instead of armor
description:
In 2003, American weapons designers completed an unprecedented crash project: the GBU-43/B Massive Ordnance Air Blast, nicknamed the Mother of All Bombs. Built too large to fit inside any conventional bomber, the weapon required an entirely new method of aerial deployment.

From its explosive testing at Eglin Air Force Base to its sole combat deployment in the mountains of eastern Afghanistan, this is the story of the most powerful conventional explosive ever dropped in battle.

Key points:
- Why the bomb had to be rolled out of a cargo transport plane
- How an air burst creates crushing shockwaves without digging a crater
- The 2017 strike against a fortified mountain cave complex

Based on the Wikipedia article "GBU-43/B MOAB" (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/GBU-43/B_MOAB), licensed CC BY-SA 4.0.
